btc_filter.description: BTC must pass ALL conditions before any long trade is considered on any symbol
required_for_longs: BTC price is above its Gaussian Channel filter
BTC Supertrend is bullish (price above Supertrend line)
BTC UT Bot Sell has NOT fired on the current bar
btc_filter.current_status: BEARISH — BTC Supertrend flipped SHORT on 2026-05-27. No longs until BTC reclaims Gaussian filter and Supertrend flips back long.

entry_criteria.description: ALL three conditions must be true simultaneously on the 4H chart to enter a long
required: UT Bot Buy = 1 fired on current or previous bar
Supertrend is bullish (price above Supertrend line)
disqualifiers: Never enter long if Supertrend is above price (counter-trend)
Never enter if BTC filter conditions are not met
Never enter in the first 15 minutes of the NY session open

bullish: Price is above EMA 21 on the 4H
Supertrend is bullish (price above Supertrend line)
Price is above the Gaussian Channel filter
BTC filter is green (BTC above its Gaussian filter and Supertrend bullish)
bearish: Price is below EMA 21 on the 4H
Supertrend is bearish (price below Supertrend line)
Price is below the Gaussian Channel filter or low band
BTC Supertrend is bearish or BTC UT Bot Sell has fired
neutral: Supertrend is bullish but BTC filter is not fully green
Price is between Gaussian filter and low band

partial_profits: T1 hit: sell 25% of position, move stop to break-even (entry price)
T2 hit: sell another 25% of position, hold remaining 50%
stop_management: Initial stop: below most recent swing low or key support level
After T1: move stop to entry (break-even)
After T2: move stop to T1 level
exit_triggers: UT Bot Sell fires: exit 100% immediately
BTC Supertrend flips short: consider tightening stops or exiting

risk_rules: Only take trades where R:R is at least 1:2
No trading in the first 15 minutes of the NY session open
If I have 2 losing trades in a row, stop for the day
No counter-trend trades — never long if Supertrend is above price
No longs when BTC Supertrend is bearish
notes: BTC Supertrend flipped SHORT on 2026-05-27. Market is in full risk-off mode. No new longs until BTC reclaims Gaussian filter ($75,727) and Supertrend flips back long. Update this note when BTC structure changes.
